workGlove.reason: Visible bent thumb and several leather finger ends attached to palm, not an anonymous edge.

adjustableWrench.reason: Attached fixed/moving jaw, adjusting worm wheel and neck; handle continues left.

review.recipe: One heavy rocks glass; hazy amber bourbon/lemon/honey sour with one cloudy smooth freezer cube, thin honey bubble ring and no garnish/egg. Formula unchanged; colour is warm amber rather than the palest possible read.
review.personality: Worn glove and small adjustable wrench are recognizable but spread much too far to the right; this is the preserved pre-correction master, not a phone-safe candidate.
review.world: Dark historic timber room and practical lamp. Wood remains conspicuously warm/glossy on right and worn-grain detail is somewhat busy; no etched ice motif, large clear glass areas.
issues: Whole glass/paper/glove/wrench union x752–1655 is 903 px; portrait and tall-phone cover cannot retain all.
Tag writable field is ample and physically tied, but original wide group is oversized.
Warm glossy table highlights and dense worn leather microtexture deserve material review.
